quotes.text: I’ve spent a lot of time listening to data center developers trying to explain why they should build here. In the rooms I’ve been in and in the projects I’ve seen, there is no project anywhere in NEPA that should move forward.

We obviously are not going to stop AI. That’s not the goal. But we can work together to figure it out. We do need federal regulation and guardrails around AI. I do not see this Congress or this administration doing any of that. We need, in a new Congress, to call for guardrails, call for monitoring, call for a federal AI regulator.
So the link between the data center buildout, the Big Tech companies, and the AI push is directly related to the squeeze that we’re feeling in our bills here in Northeastern Pennsylvania.
We also need to regulate AI. This current administration and Congress have no desire to regulate AI. We have need a federal monitor.

Rob Bresnahan has embraced the data center boom while standing to profit from it. I’m focused on protecting NEPA from speculative developers and in Congress, I'll push for guardrails including a federal AI regulator,
